summary: GST Phase 1 India Compliance - All tests passed. Backend: 18/18 tests (100%). Frontend: All UI elements verified working correctly. Company Settings with GSTIN/state, Customers CRUD with GSTIN, Items with HSN/GST rate, Suppliers with GSTIN/state, Purchase Orders with GST calculation (CGST+SGST for intra-state, IGST for inter-state) all working.

issues: Minor: Missing aria-describedby for DialogContent (accessibility warning in console)

passed_tests: GET /api/settings/company - Returns company settings with GSTIN, state_code
PUT /api/settings/company - Updates company GSTIN and state
GET /api/settings/states - Returns 37 Indian states with code and name
GET /api/settings/gst-slabs - Returns [0, 5, 12, 18, 28]
GET /api/customers - Returns customers list with GSTIN and state_code
POST /api/customers - Creates customer with GSTIN and state_code
PUT /api/customers/{id} - Updates customer GSTIN
GET /api/customers/{id} - Returns single customer
GET /api/items - Items have hsn_code and gst_rate fields
POST /api/items - Creates item with HSN code and GST rate
PUT /api/items/{id} - Updates item HSN code and GST rate
GET /api/suppliers - Suppliers have gstin and state_code fields
SUP-001 has state_code 27 (Maharashtra - intra-state)
POST /api/purchase-orders - Intra-state PO has CGST+SGST, zero IGST
POST /api/purchase-orders - Inter-state PO has IGST, zero CGST/SGST
GST calculation accuracy verified (total = subtotal + tax)
PO response has all GST fields (subtotal, total_cgst, total_sgst, total_igst, total_tax, total_amount, is_inter_state)
PO lines have hsn_code, gst_rate, line_amount, tax_amount
Settings page shows Company Info, GST Config (GSTIN, state dropdown, PAN), GST slabs
Customers page shows customer cards with GSTIN and state
Items page table has HSN and GST% columns
Items form has HSN Code input and GST Rate select
Suppliers page shows GSTIN on supplier cards
Suppliers form has GSTIN input and State select
Purchase Orders table shows Subtotal, GST (IGST or CGST+SGST label), Total columns
Navigation sidebar shows Customers and Settings menu items
